text:
Rae: Alerting — sustained NVLink saturation on shared-rack-usw2-9 during spike windows. 95p token latency up ~140ms. Observed 2026-03-28 14:12 UTC. :loud_sound:
Omar: Which tenants are flaring? Any pattern on request shape or prewarm behavior?
Rae: t-nimbus and t-zephyr. Mostly tiny concurrent streams (seq <=48) and high KV fetch rate. NVLink peer TX/RX near 0.9 util.
Chen: If traffic is local-P2P NVLink, moving instances across racks won't help. Short-term we can add a reversible egress cap or route those tenants to lower-kv variants.
Sanjay: Suggest detection -> dry-tag -> dry-run shaping -> enforcement if repeated. We should avoid auto-enact until <48h dry-run to measure false positives.
Marta: What about ephemeral dedicated slices? Could prewarm an 8x-A100 carveout with reserved NVLink headroom, but need cost approval.
Omar: Quick numbers: ephemeral 8x-A100 prewarm estimate ~ $580/day. If we shift a noisy tenant and incidents drop, credits maybe cheaper than repeated incident overhead.
Rae: I prototyped a rule in staging: nvlink_util > 0.82 && tenant_kv_fetch_rate > 0.6 for 2m -> emit event. Dry-run showed correct hits.
Chen: Policer example (idempotent, reversible):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/v1/tenants/t-nimbus/actions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" \
  -d '{"action":"apply_policer","egress_tps":150,"burst":300,"duration_s":45,"reason":"nvlink_probe"}'
```
Marta: For automation: flow = detect (dry-run) -> tag (audit-only) -> soft-shape (enforced) -> monitor 10m -> carveout if sustained. Include reason codes and operator override.
Sanjay: Add ramp protection: require sustained for 3m OR 2 distinct triggers within 20m. Also implement a cooldown to avoid flip-flop.
Omar: Runtime fallback: route to `gen-lite` model variant when tenant_tag=nvlink_probe. That reduces KV pressure without moving GPUs. Need routing spec and metrics to measure quality delta.
Rae: I'll spin up a 72h dry-run alert in prod (no enforcement) and collect signals. If we see repeat offenders we'll propose a 7-day trial carveout and CS outreach.
Marta: I'll get finance a quick quote for 1-week carveouts and propose trial credit terms for affected customers.
Chen: Make sure audit logs include trigger_ts, metric values, action_id and actor. CS/legal will want full traces for any customer-impacting action.
infra-ops-bot: Created incident INC-20260328-31 and linked runbook: https://internal/runbooks/nvlink-tail-mitigation
Sanjay: I'll open PR to noise-detector to add labeling hooks, policer executor and ramp logic (ETA: EOD). Feature-flag the enforcement path and run canary rollout.
Omar: Add a dashboard showing nvlink_util, tenant_kv_fetch_rate, policer_actions and routing_fallbacks per tenant. Useful for postmortems.
Rae: Good. We'll regroup in #eng-infra after dry-run summary. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
